HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.
   D. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   B. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   B. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Religious has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   C. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
   D. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
